_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: collections
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (id, default_preset_id) REFERENCES presets (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

data.name: visible_collections
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_collections AS SELECT id FROM collections WHERE deleted = 0

data.name: decks
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, parent_id) REFERENCES decks (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, preset_id) REFERENCES presets (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

data.name: visible_decks
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_decks AS WITH RECURSIVE visible (id) AS (SELECT id FROM decks WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND deleted = 0 AND collection_id IN (SELECT id FROM visible_collections) UNION SELECT d.id FROM decks AS d JOIN visible AS v ON d.parent_id = v.id WHERE d.deleted = 0) SELECT id FROM visible

data.name: tags
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, parent_id) REFERENCES tags (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

data.name: visible_tags
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_tags AS WITH RECURSIVE visible (id) AS (SELECT id FROM tags WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND deleted = 0 AND collection_id IN (SELECT id FROM visible_collections) UNION SELECT t.id FROM tags AS t JOIN visible AS v ON t.parent_id = v.id WHERE t.deleted = 0) SELECT id FROM visible

data.name: visible_note_types
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_note_types AS SELECT t.id FROM note_types AS t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_collections AS c WHERE c.id = t.collection_id)

data.name: visible_field_definitions
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_field_definitions AS SELECT f.id FROM field_definitions AS f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_note_types AS t WHERE t.id = f.note_type_id)

data.name: visible_study_card_templates
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_study_card_templates AS SELECT s.id FROM study_card_templates AS s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_note_types AS t WHERE t.id = s.note_type_id)

data.name: notes
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_type_id) REFERENCES note_types (collection_id, id)
CHECK (source_reference IS NULL OR source_kind IS NOT NULL)

data.name: study_cards
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_id) REFERENCES notes (collection_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, deck_id) REFERENCES decks (collection_id, id)

data.name: visible_study_cards
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_study_cards AS SELECT c.id, c.note_id FROM study_cards AS c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notes AS n WHERE n.id = c.note_id AND n.deleted = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_study_card_templates AS s WHERE s.id = c.template_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_decks AS d WHERE d.id = c.deck_id)

data.name: visible_notes
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_notes AS SELECT n.id FROM notes AS n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_note_types AS t WHERE t.id = n.note_type_id) AND(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_study_cards AS c WHERE c.note_id = n.id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM study_cards AS c WHERE c.note_id = n.id))

data.name: visible_note_fields
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_note_fields AS SELECT v.note_id, v.field_id, v.value FROM note_fields AS v WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_notes AS n WHERE n.id = v.note_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_field_definitions AS f WHERE f.id = v.field_id)

data.name: note_tags
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_id) REFERENCES notes (collection_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, tag_id) REFERENCES tags (collection_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

data.name: visible_note_tags
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_note_tags AS SELECT l.note_id, l.tag_id FROM note_tags AS l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_notes AS n WHERE n.id = l.note_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_tags AS t WHERE t.id = l.tag_id)

data.name: visible_media_assets
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_media_assets AS SELECT m.collection_id, m.hash, m.mime_type, m.size_bytes, m.original_name FROM media_assets AS m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_collections AS c WHERE c.id = m.collection_id)

data.name: preset_versions
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (preset_id) REFERENCES presets (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

data.name: presets
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (id, current_version_id) REFERENCES preset_versions (preset_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

data.name: visible_presets
data.sql: CREATE VIEW visible_presets AS SELECT p.id FROM presets AS p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_collections AS c WHERE c.id = p.collection_id)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_preset_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "day_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (id, default_preset_id) REFERENCES presets (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);
CREATE VIEW visible_collections AS SELECT id FROM collections WHERE deleted = 0

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "decks" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "parent_id" BLOB NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "preset_id" BLOB NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, parent_id) REFERENCES decks (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, preset_id) REFERENCES presets (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE VIEW visible_decks AS WITH RECURSIVE visible (id) AS (SELECT id FROM decks WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND deleted = 0 AND collection_id IN (SELECT id FROM visible_collections) UNION SELECT d.id FROM decks AS d JOIN visible AS v ON d.parent_id = v.id WHERE d.deleted = 0) SELECT id FROM visible

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "parent_id" BLOB NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, parent_id) REFERENCES tags (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE VIEW visible_tags AS WITH RECURSIVE visible (id) AS (SELECT id FROM tags WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND deleted = 0 AND collection_id IN (SELECT id FROM visible_collections) UNION SELECT t.id FROM tags AS t JOIN visible AS v ON t.parent_id = v.id WHERE t.deleted = 0) SELECT id FROM visible

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_types" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"));
CREATE VIEW visible_note_types AS SELECT t.id FROM note_types AS t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_collections AS c WHERE c.id = t.collection_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_definitions" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "note_type_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES note_types (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE VIEW visible_field_definitions AS SELECT f.id FROM field_definitions AS f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_note_types AS t WHERE t.id = f.note_type_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_card_templates" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "note_type_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES note_types (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE VIEW visible_study_card_templates AS SELECT s.id FROM study_card_templates AS s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_note_types AS t WHERE t.id = s.note_type_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "note_type_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NULL, "source_reference" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_type_id) REFERENCES note_types (collection_id, id), CHECK (source_reference IS NULL OR source_kind IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_cards" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "note_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "template_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES study_card_templates (id), "deck_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("note_id", "template_id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_id) REFERENCES notes (collection_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, deck_id) REFERENCES decks (collection_id, id));

CREATE VIEW visible_study_cards AS SELECT c.id, c.note_id FROM study_cards AS c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notes AS n WHERE n.id = c.note_id AND n.deleted = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_study_card_templates AS s WHERE s.id = c.template_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_decks AS d WHERE d.id = c.deck_id)

CREATE VIEW visible_notes AS SELECT n.id FROM notes AS n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_note_types AS t WHERE t.id = n.note_type_id) AND(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_study_cards AS c WHERE c.note_id = n.id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM study_cards AS c WHERE c.note_id = n.id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_fields" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "note_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "field_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES field_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_id", "field_id"));

CREATE VIEW visible_note_fields AS SELECT v.note_id, v.field_id, v.value FROM note_fields AS v WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_notes AS n WHERE n.id = v.note_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_field_definitions AS f WHERE f.id = v.field_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_tags" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "note_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "tag_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_id", "tag_id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_id) REFERENCES notes (collection_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, tag_id) REFERENCES tags (collection_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE VIEW visible_note_tags AS SELECT l.note_id, l.tag_id FROM note_tags AS l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_notes AS n WHERE n.id = l.note_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_tags AS t WHERE t.id = l.tag_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_assets" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "hash" BLOB NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collection_id", "hash"));

CREATE VIEW visible_media_assets AS SELECT m.collection_id, m.hash, m.mime_type, m.size_bytes, m.original_name FROM media_assets AS m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_collections AS c WHERE c.id = m.collection_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preset_versions" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "preset_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "scheduler_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduler_config" TEXT NOT NULL, "burn_threshold_days" INTEGER NULL, "leech_threshold" INTEGER NULL, "new_cards_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reviews_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_card_mix" TEXT NOT NULL, "new_card_order" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("preset_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (preset_id) REFERENCES presets (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "presets" ("hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_version_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (id, current_version_id) REFERENCES preset_versions (preset_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);
CREATE VIEW visible_presets AS SELECT p.id FROM presets AS p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible_collections AS c WHERE c.id = p.collection_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "node" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_hlc" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" BLOB NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_table", "entity_key"));
CREATE INDEX outbox_hlc ON outbox (hlc)
CREATE INDEX study_cards_deck ON study_cards (collection_id, deck_id)
CREATE INDEX study_cards_template ON study_cards (template_id)
CREATE INDEX study_cards_hlc ON study_cards (hlc)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_events" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "study_card_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES study_cards (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "utc_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state_before" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade" TEXT NULL, "response_time" INTEGER NULL, "due_before" INTEGER NULL, "due_after" INTEGER NULL, "undone_event_id" BLOB NULL REFERENCES review_events (id), "scheduler_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduler_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preset_version_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES preset_versions (id), "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduling_states" ("study_card_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES study_cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "due" INTEGER NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ease" REAL NULL, "step" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL, "review_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_event_id" BLOB NULL REFERENCES review_events (id), PRIMARY KEY ("study_card_id"));
CREATE INDEX review_events_card ON review_events (study_card_id, at)
CREATE INDEX review_events_at ON review_events (at)
CREATE INDEX review_events_hlc ON review_events (hlc)
CREATE INDEX scheduling_states_due ON scheduling_states (state, due)
CREATE INDEX presets_collection ON presets (collection_id)
CREATE INDEX presets_hlc ON presets (hlc)
CREATE INDEX preset_versions_hlc ON preset_versions (hlc)
CREATE INDEX note_types_collection ON note_types (collection_id)
CREATE INDEX note_types_hlc ON note_types (hlc)
CREATE INDEX field_definitions_note_type ON field_definitions (note_type_id)
